items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I used to say to the General (Hübner)... he said, I understand Mac, I understand. He was marvellous to me.

ctx.x: Yes, that's right. I used to say to the General (Hübner), I'd say General, my corfnet needs repairing and there's only one place to get it fixed and that's in Paris General. You know, he said, I understand Mac, I understand. (LAUGHTER). He was marvellous to me. I'd go to Paris and back.

Anyway, when we got, oh I don't suppose you want to hear more about this. I got my discharge in Paris and went with one of the USO camp shows for a six month period. And Celeste Holm was our star and I was the orchestra leader and Marian was the manager of the show. And we went to the Nuremberg Trials about the fifth month or so.
